# V2.4.3 - Watcher

Fate UI now recovers a stale Windows lock when the previous owner is gone, even if Node cannot check its PID. A running owner still keeps the lock.

Long Agent Team sessions now compact superseded checkpoints while keeping the conversation and the latest Team state on existing branches. A saved chat over 128 MiB can still be previewed, but Fate UI won't load it into the live runtime. Basic fault details are saved locally even when stack reporting is off.
